We know you want tools that save time, simplify your day-to-day tasks, and make it easier to grow with confidence—and we’re continually improving Etsy to support those needs.

This page highlights recent features, tools, and improvements for sellers. It’s updated periodically to give you a quick overview of what’s new. Some updates may not be listed here. Check [Etsy News](https://www.etsy.com/news), the [Etsy Forums](https://community.etsy.com/feed/) and [Site Updates in the Seller Handbook](https://www.etsy.com/seller-handbook/category/site-updates?ref=handbook) for more information on what’s new at Etsy.

Jump to a section:

- [June 2026](#h_1)
- [March 2026](#h_2)

## June 2026

## Updates to help make your shop easier to run

### **Expanded Etsy Purchase Protection coverage**

Based on seller feedback, we’ve updated Etsy Purchase Protection to give you clearer expectations and stronger support when issues happen outside your control. Changes include:

- Coverage up to $250 USD for eligible orders, even when the order total is higher
- Refreshed eligibility guidance
- More human review for complex cases

[Learn more](https://www.etsy.com/seller-handbook/article/introducing-etsys-purchase-protection/1085799204521)

### **Detailed policy violation information**

We've added more detailed information to the Policy violations page so you can better understand why a listing may have violated Etsy policies. With clearer explanations and additional context, you can make informed updates to get your listings back on track and better understand how to stay compliant with Etsy's policies going forward.

[Learn more](https://www.etsy.com/seller-handbook/article/1402820802974)

--- FILE 5: data/etsy/help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013196707-how-to-purchase-an-item-on-etsy-e3b5b2c3872e.md ---

url: "https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013196707-How-to-Purchase-an-Item-On-Etsy"
title: "How to Purchase an Item On Etsy – Etsy Help"
language: "en"
content_hash: e7dbf61a5c4877241099f021c86f8b9adee67de15047a227f496c7155f3008c8
---

When you buy on Etsy, you're supporting a small business by purchasing from an individual seller.

To purchase an item on Etsy, find an item you’re looking for, add it to your cart, and complete the checkout process. This guide will help you get started. 

Did you receive an Etsy gift card? [Redeem a gift card](https://www.etsy.com/redeem) and [learn how to pay with it](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015439127?segment=shopping).

Jump to a section:

- [Find what you're looking for](#h_1)
- [Complete the checkout process](#h_2)
- [After you complete your order](#h_3)

## Find what you’re looking for

If you need a little help finding your next purchase, here are a few tips:

- Check [Editors’ Picks](https://www.etsy.com/featured) for items hand-picked by Etsy staffers.
- Go to [Gifts](https://www.etsy.com/gift-mode) to browse giftable items for different personalities, tastes, and celebrations. [Learn more about buying gifts on Etsy.](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/20646657966231?segment=shopping)
- Use the Etsy search bar and filter for items on sale, shop location, color, and more. [Learn more tips for searching on Etsy](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015627947?segment=shopping).
- Check shops’ reviews, policies, badges, and shipping times to help guide your decision.
- If you’re shopping for someone else, consider an [Etsy gift card](https://www.etsy.com/giftcards) so your recipient can purchase exactly what they want. [Learn how to buy a gift card.](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015521288?segment=shopping)

### What if I find items I love, but I’m not ready to buy them?

To keep track of items you love on Etsy, you can add them to your Favorites by selecting the heart icons on listings. You can also curate collections of your favorites that you can return to anytime, like shopping lists. 

[Learn how to keep track of your favorite items and shops](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015439627).

## Complete the checkout process

Once you’ve found the perfect item, complete your purchase by checking out on either [Etsy.com](http://etsy.com) or the Etsy app. You can [sign in or create an Etsy account](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015568007), or [check out as a guest](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015663607-How-to-Check-Out-as-a-Guest-on-Etsy?segment=shopping).

[Learn how to use a coupon code or make an offer.](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015570787)

--- FILE 6: data/etsy/help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013197687-how-to-leave-a-review-on-etsy-85a68769aed0.md ---
Size: 12K
Type: Unicode text, UTF-8 text, with very long lines (379)
---
url: "https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013197687-How-to-Leave-a-Review-on-Etsy"
title: "How to Leave a Review on Etsy – Etsy Help"
language: "en"
content_hash: dc56ab1bafc5005c789de0c1af4a05bd9af760f03c99a15c75c1909b465e12f4
---

You can leave a review from your **Purchases** page:

[Go to Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases)

1. Sign in to [Etsy.com](https://www.etsy.com/) and go to **Your account**. On the Etsy app, sign in and tap **You**.
2. Go to [Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases).
3. Find the item you want to review.
4. Choose the star rating next to **Review this item**.
5. Describe the item and the service you received. Additionally you can choose a star rating for the Item Quality, Shipping, and Seller Customer Service.
6. Choose whether to add a photo or video to your review.
7. Select **Submit Review**.

Alternatively, you can leave a review through the **Reviews** tab.

1. Sign in to [Etsy.com](https://www.etsy.com/) and go to **Your account**. On the Etsy app, sign in and tap **You**.
2. Go to **Reviews**.
3. Find the item you want to review. If you only have one item to review, it will automatically be selected.
4. Choose the star rating you wish to give the item.
5. Describe the item and the service you received. Additionally you can choose a star rating for the Item Quality, Shipping, and Seller Customer Service.
6. Choose whether to add a photo or video to your review.
7. Select **Submit.**

Jump to a section:

- [The five-star review system](#115013197687_1)
- [Which items can be reviewed?](#115013197687_2)
- [Can I edit my review?](#115013197687_3)

## The five-star review system

On Etsy, 1 star is the lowest and 5 stars is the highest. A shop’s rating is the average of the reviews they’ve received in the past 12 months.

Choose a star rating and describe your experience. The more detailed your review, the more helpful it will be to other shoppers on Etsy. Your display name and link to your public Etsy profile will be publicly displayed in the seller's reviews. 

--- FILE 7: data/etsy/help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013293148-372245bc4743.md ---
Size: 4.0K
Type: Unicode text, UTF-8 text, with very long lines (351)
---
url: "https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013293148?segment=shopping#date"
title: "When Can I Leave a Review for My Order? – Etsy Help"
language: "en"
content_hash: b2319ef43a656ec57b0648cc2590ff043e17aac80890d38177f526aa02c075a6
---

You can leave a review after [the date your order is estimated to be delivered](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/360020601674?segment=shopping). You’ll see **Leave a review or report an issue on [date]** with the order on your [Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases) page.

### **How long do I have to leave a review?**

From your estimated delivery date, you have 100 days to [leave a review](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115013197687?segment=shopping) and 30 days to [open a case](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/5745586898199).

### **How can I leave a review if I purchased an item as a guest?**

If you purchased as a guest, you’ll need to [connect your order to an Etsy account](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015565027) before leaving a review or opening a case.  

### **When can I leave a review for a digital item?**

If you purchased a digital item, you can leave a review once you download the file.

--- FILE 9: data/etsy/help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013328108-how-to-download-a-digital-item-241d5c4ad368.md ---

url: "https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013328108-How-to-Download-a-Digital-Item"
title: "How to Download a Digital Item – Etsy Help"
language: "en"
content_hash: 53443c8c4730a1facb8f11175382655990f4f489c0b99eaa645c834042e7c864
---

**Quick answer**

Digital items you’ve purchased can be viewed and downloaded from the [Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases?ref=hdr_user_menu-txs) section of your Etsy account.

If you have questions about an item or order, your seller is the best person to help you.

[Contact seller](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases/select_order)

There are 2 kinds of digital purchases: 

- Instant downloads: Ready-made files that are available once your payment is confirmed. If you paid with PayPal or a credit card on Etsy, it may take a few minutes for your download link to be sent to you.
- Made-to-order downloads: Digital items that the seller will make to your specifications after you purchase them. The seller will send your files to you once they have completed them.

When your digital files are available for download, you will receive an email. Select **View your files on Etsy** to be taken to the [Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases?ref=hdr_user_menu-txs) section of your Etsy account to download files.

You can't download a digital purchase through the Etsy app at this time. To download a digital file, please sign in to Etsy on your mobile browser or computer.

## **I can’t find my download notification email**

First, check your spam or junk inbox. If you use Gmail, also check your *Social* and *Promotions* tabs. If it’s not there, adding *transaction@account.etsy.com* or *noreply@etsy.com* to your address book or safe list can help you locate these emails in the future.

For now, you can still access your digital purchases in your account.

## **Where can I find my digital purchases in my account?**

To access your digital files from your account:

1. Sign in to [Etsy.com](http://www.etsy.com) and go to **Your** **account**.
2. Go to [**Purchases**](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases).
3. Next to the order, select **Download Files**. This goes to the **Downloads** page for all the files attached to your order.

You can also select **View Receipt** at the top of an item’s listing page to go to [Purchases](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases), where you can download the item.

**Quick answer**

If you need help with your order:

[Choose your order](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases/select_order)

If the order's maximum estimated delivery date has passed, and you've contacted the seller for help more than 48 hours ago, choose **Open a case** so Etsy can help you. For qualifying orders, you’ll receive a refund for any item that doesn’t arrive, arrives damaged, or doesn’t match the item description or photos.

Contacting a seller through **Messages** is the best way to get information about an item or resolve any issues you have with your order. Each seller on Etsy manages their own orders, and makes decisions about cancellations, refunds, and returns. [Learn more about getting help with your order](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/4402660818583?segment=shopping).

## How to contact a shop before buying

1. Sign in to your Etsy account if you haven't already, or [create an account](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015568007).
2. On a listing page, select **Message Seller**.
3. Type your message into the text box.
4. After you **Send** your message, the seller will be notified and can respond.

1. Sign in to your Etsy account if you haven't already, or [create an account](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015568007).
2. On a listing, tap the message icon on the listing photo.
3. Type your question into the text box.
4. After you **Send** your message, the seller will be notified and can respond.

## How to check if an item will arrive quickly

If you find an item you want to purchase on Etsy, you can check its [estimated delivery date](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/360020601674).

**Quick answer**

If you need help with your order:

[Choose your order](https://www.etsy.com/your/purchases/select_order)

If the order's maximum estimated delivery date has passed, and you've contacted the seller for help more than 48 hours ago, choose **Open a case** so Etsy can help you. For qualifying orders, you’ll receive a refund for any item that doesn’t arrive, arrives damaged, or doesn’t match the item description or photos.

Contacting a seller through **Messages** is the best way to get information about an item or resolve any issues you have with your order. Each seller on Etsy manages their own orders, and makes decisions about cancellations, refunds, and returns. [Learn more about getting help with your order](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/4402660818583?segment=shopping).

## I’m a seller with an open shop

--- FILE 14: data/etsy/help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013946647-75cdd1268a2f.md ---

url: "https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013946647"
title: "How to Set Up Calculated Shipping – Etsy Help"
language: "en"
content_hash: c1190a671ca22291d03e06c0ba5e0d880e6931340c4bfd9987f479e6a953e812
---

If you’re located in the US or Canada and you ship your orders with the USPS, Global Postal Shipping, or Canada Post, you can use calculated shipping on Etsy. If you purchase shipping labels on Etsy, the package details from the order are automatically imported into the shipping label purchase page.

Setting up calculated shipping has several steps:

1. Set up a shipping profile with calculated shipping
2. Add size and weight information to your listings
3. Add the calculated shipping profile to your listings

If an item is too big or too small to ship as a USPS, Global Postal Shipping, or Canada Post package, you can still [set your own shipping rates later.](#size)

## **How does calculated shipping work?**

Calculated shipping combines your location, the buyer’s location, and the item’s size and weight to generate shipping costs for orders.

If you enable calculated shipping for your listings, buyers can preview their shipping costs by entering either their zip/postal code or country. We default to the least expensive shipping method that is eligible for the total weight and dimensions of the item.

You’ll see all of the shipping details on both your [Sold Orders](https://www.etsy.com/your/orders/sold) and Receipt pages that show the package type, package dimensions, and package weight.

This video (in English) shows how to use shipping profiles to set up calculated shipping:

To set up a calculated shipping profile:

1. On [Etsy.com](https://www.etsy.com/), select **[Shop Manager](https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/dashboard).**
2. Choose **Settings**.
3. Choose [**Shipping settings**](https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/tools/shipping-profiles).
4. Select **Edit** next to an existing profile or **Create profile**.
5. Select **Calculate them for me** next to **Shipping costs**.
6. Enter the origin zip/postal code where you’ll ship your orders from. Shipping rates will be calculated based on this location.
7. Confirm which countries you ship to. Your shop country is a required shipping destination, but you can add or remove other countries. To ship only to your shop country, remove the checkmark from **All countries**.
8. Confirm which shipping services you’d like to offer.
9. Choose if you’d like to offer free shipping.
10. Name the shipping profile.
11. Select **Save****profile**.

Streamline your shipping process and entice buyers with competitive shipping rates using Etsy’s shipping tools.

- Save your shipping settings across multiple listings using shipping profiles.
- Offer discounted shipping when buyers purchase multiple items.
- Offer buyers the option to pay more for faster shipping.

You can also use free shipping to entice buyers to complete a purchase. [Learn more about offering free shipping.](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/360000343368?segment=selling)

Starting July 9, orders shipping into the US will need to include duties and import fees upfront to keep your shop eligible for [Etsy Purchase Protection](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/5850122619287). [Learn more and explore resources to help you manage cross-border selling more easily](https://www.etsy.com/seller-handbook/article/1355662653395).

## How do I add shipping rates?

If you don't want to use calculated shipping, add shipping rates when creating or editing a listing. Be sure to set a rate for each country you'd like to ship items. Many buyers only see Etsy listings that ship to their country.

1. Go to your [**Shipping settings**](https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/tools/shipping-profiles?ref=seller-platform-mcnav).
2. Under **Shipping profiles**, select **Create profile**.
3. In the **Shipping prices** section, choose **I’ll enter fixed prices manually**.
4. Enter the **Ship from country** and **Origin Zip code** you’re shipping from.
5. Choose the item’s **Processing time** - how long it will take you to prepare and ship the order.
6. Choose the **Shipping service**.
7. For shipping within your country, under **What you’ll charge**, choose **Free shipping** or **Fixed price** if you don’t want to include shipping costs in the item price.
   - If you choose **Fixed price**, enter how much you’ll charge for **One item** or **Additional item**. The additional item rate will be applied if a buyer purchases more than one of this item or another item within your shop, and this listing’s shipping is less or equal to the other item.
8. If you’d like to sell the item outside your country, set a rate for **Everywhere Else** or choose **Add another location** to set your own rates for specific locations.
   - **Everywhere Else** will cover anywhere else you don’t choose your own rate for. You can remove it by selecting the trash can icon if you only want to sell to specific countries.

## How to create a promo code

Buyers can receive discounts during checkout using promo codes you’ve set up for your shop. You can share codes with buyers in [Messages](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015654988), in your [shop announcement](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/360000343708), on social media, or anywhere else where you interact with your customers. 

To create a promo code:

1. On [Etsy.com](https://www.etsy.com/), go to your **Shop Manager**.
2. In the **Marketing** tab, select [**Sales and Discounts**](https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/sales-coupons).
3. Choose **Create a promo code**.
4. Select the options you’d like for your discount.
5. Choose which individual listings will be eligible for this promo code, or select **Add all active listings**.
6. Review the details for your promo code, and select **Confirm and create code**.

### **What are the available discount types?**

When creating a promo code, you can choose from the following discount types:

- **Percentage off**: Offer any percentage off between 5% and 75% off the list price of items in your shop. The percentage off must be a whole number.
- **Fixed amount off**: Offer a fixed amount off the list price of items in your shop.
- **Free standard shipping**: The shopper won’t pay a shipping fee. You can choose to only offer free shipping on domestic orders or selected regions. [Learn how to offer free shipping](https://www.etsy.com/seller-handbook/article/smart-strategies-for-running-a-free/176426041624).

If you choose to only offer a percentage-off discount on certain listings, you will need to manually add new listings to your existing promo codes. You can [edit the sale or discount](https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/sales-coupons) later to include them.

## Returns & exchanges

From this tab, you can create and edit the various return and exchange policies that you use when selling non-digital items on Etsy. These policies are applied as you see fit to your individual listings rather than being a blanket return policy for your entire shop. 

If you’re a seller outside of the EU, you must set a return policy whenever you edit or create a new listing for a physical item, even if it is to let buyers know you do not accept returns or exchanges on that listing. 

[Learn how to set return policies on your listings](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/7869401615255?segment=selling).

**EU right of withdrawal**

Regulations in the EU give buyers the right to cancel or return their orders within 14 days of delivery. If you set your return policy to less than 14 days, a banner reminding you of the EU right of withdrawal will appear on your Returns and exchanges policy page.

Read more about [how EU regulations may affect your shop.](https://www.etsy.com/legal/policy/eu-directive-on-consumer-rights/242644519829)

If you are a “trader” that sells to EU/EEA states, there may be additional information that needs to be added to your individual listings under General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) requirements.

content_hash: 6984bb03565d358f9c0693d55faec74af09688d44931aa9187b97a91a0f6ea22

When you sell on Etsy, you incur fees for using certain services. 

Your balance from sales, fees, and taxes is calculated and displayed in your Payment account. [Learn how to manage your Payment account](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/115015747228).

If you’re enrolled in Etsy Payments, your fees are automatically deducted from funds from sales. If your balance is negative at the end of the month, you’ll have an amount due on the first of the next month. When your outstanding balance is due, you’ll receive an email from Etsy.

### **Currency conversion**

All fixed-cost fees, like listings and Pattern, are published in USD. You can see the fixed USD cost for a fee in its description. Etsy converts fees from USD to your payment account currency at the market rate at the time the fee is reflected in your payment account. This conversion may change if currency exchange rates change.
